description: This file defines the Pagination class for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It generates pagination controls based on total items, current page, limit per page, and URL pattern. It provides methods to produce pagination links such as previous, next, first, last, and the range of page links.

classes.name: Pagination
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating pagination links for displaying paginated content in the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates pagination data and view based on provided settings including total items, current page, limit, and URL pattern.
